label: T-26 RUN3-43623162108 vs merge candidate (upstream master a4ba8240 merge + firewall4 fullcone re-anchor; kernel config unchanged, kernel patch set changed -> merge-class kernel delta, build stamps re-rolled)

kernelPayload.reason: Kernel config hash is unchanged (6.18.60~106ff47d01ccbcbd01e3661d209d54cd-r1), target/linux/generic/kernel-6.18 is byte-identical (LINUX_VERSION-6.18 = .60) and the tree seed/config are unchanged, so no kernel CONFIG changed. The upstream merge a4ba8240 did, however, update the reference kernel patch set: 13 files under target/linux/generic/patches-6.18 changed (757 OEM SFP+ONU quirk; 802-01..04 phylib/usb PHY interrupt handling; 904-debloat_dma_buf; 750-753 SFP quirks; 792 wireguard sticky source address; 801-01/896-03 net-phy), so built-in kernel code legitimately recompiles and kernel-deep-compare reports NON-STAMP-DIFF (2,371,928 differing decompressed bytes in 253,931 ranges, decompressed size unchanged at 13,159,680 B). Accepted as merge-class only via verify-task26.sh --kernel-merge-class, which re-derives: kernel config hash unchanged, kernel-6.18 unchanged, seed/config unchanged, every changed kernel-input path confined to target/linux/{generic,sanechips}, include/kernel-{defaults,version}.mk or package/kernel, and at least one target/linux/generic patch changed; the file list is written to kernel-merge-class-<tag>.json. Residual risk: kernel behaviour follows the upstream reference kernel patches; no e2631-specific kernel patch changed.
